entities.name: PPDK regulatory protein
observations: The 280-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry A1AT85 from Pelobacter propionicus.
Annotated as a bifunctional serine/threonine kinase and phosphorylase regulating pyruvate phosphate dikinase (PPDK).
Contains Pfam Kinase-PPPase domain PF03618.21 spanning residues 4–260.

entities.name: PPDK regulatory phosphorylation
observations: Phosphorylates PPDK using ADP as the phosphoryl-group acceptor: phospho-histidyl/threonyl PPDK + ADP → phospho-histidyl/phosphothreonyl PPDK + AMP + H+.
Associated EC numbers are 2.7.11.32 and 2.7.4.27; Rhea reference includes RHEA:43692.

entities.name: PPDK regulatory dephosphorylation
observations: Dephosphorylates PPDK using inorganic phosphate: phospho-histidyl/phosphothreonyl PPDK + phosphate + H+ → phospho-histidyl/threonyl PPDK + diphosphate.
Associated EC number is 2.7.4.27; Rhea reference includes RHEA:43696.

entities.name: PPDK regulator sequence properties
observations: Length 280 aa; calculated molecular mass 31.68 kDa; theoretical pI 6.67.
Sequence analysis reports ATP and ADP binding annotations for homologous reviewed proteins.
